finalRouteAdjudication.reasonForReducedRequest: Thirty source behaviors were frozen before JS gameplay. Four prior-covered routes and one same-batch route were excluded. Twenty-five behavior candidates produced34 valid first C pairs and19 independent replays. Twelve reached routes match strictly;two further core matches have supplemental-only differences and stay outside membership. Several meaningfully different intended effects fail source/setup/roll prerequisites;all are preserved/deferred without an exhaustion claim. Request reduced17-case packet after five source-distinct actual first causes,not further rare-target probing.
finalRouteAdjudication.proofScope: All immutable109 Prep packet revisions including excluded text;fixed44 direct files in both directories;frozenv1 explicit paths;all regression recipes. Static comparisons only,no archive replays.
